**Finding: Compliant** — no non-solicitation or no-hire covenant exists in the agreement.

- Searched for all detection triggers ("solicit", "employ or engage", "hire", "induce", "recruit", "personnel"); no restrictive hiring covenant appears anywhere in the document.
- The only employment-adjacent language is the independent contractor clause (p0066), the mutual indemnities (p0051/p0052), and confidentiality handling by employees (p0061) — none restricts either party from hiring.
- This matches our preferred position (no non-solicit binding the Customer), so no redline was proposed. If Kubient introduces one in negotiation, we would push to the fallback: mutual, limited to personnel directly involved in the services, 12 months from the end of their involvement, with general-advertising and unsolicited-approach carve-outs and no "no-hire".
